verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a payments platform, but the evidence shows Adyen In-Person Payments only as a vendor-operated service. Terminals are supplied by Adyen and payments are processed on the Adyen platform, managed through its Customer Area. Local-network terminal communication and published OpenAPI definitions are adjacent integration options, not a way to self-host the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
